Name: Spiking data of dissociated rat cortical cultures on HD-MEAs during repeated-stimulation experiment
Description: Detected spikes in each session of each experiment. It has 100 sessions / 1 experiment × 27 experiment = 2,700 files. Each of them contains information about stimulation time, stimulation electrodes, recorded electrodes and detected spikes.
